title: XP Is there any script or way to offset an event sprite?

posts.author: Supergenio
posts.body:
Hey everyone! I’m working on a project in RPG Maker XP and I’m trying to figure out if there’s a way to offset the position of an event sprite—like shifting it a few pixels up, down, left, or right from its tile. I’ve been digging through the default event commands, but I can’t seem to find anything that lets me do this natively.
The idea is, I’ve created some tall windows in a town map using events—each window is 2 tiles wide and 4 tiles tall. I want to avoid using lots of separate events to switch them between night and day modes, so I designed one big character sprite to cover the whole window. However, the sprite is slightly offset (about 8-10 pixels too far to the left), and it’s not aligning perfectly with the tiles. I was wondering if there’s a script, plugin, or workaround to move or adjust the sprite’s position by those few pixels to line it up correctly.
If you know of a script, a simple explanation, or a resource I can check out, I’d really appreciate it. Thanks so much in advance!

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: Every sprite has OX and OY properties. In RGSS that means that every sprite has both the ox and the oy method.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Why not just adjust the sprite?
An event graphic will always center around the bottom center 32 pixels. I've been known to make two-tile-wide event graphics by putting them in a 96px (three tile) wide cell, offset to one side or the other so they line up correctly. I don't recall it causing any passibility problems. It might take a little fiddling to get it pixel perfect, but it's definitely doable.
